title: GULLIVR releases a new track "DEPRAVING" (feat. NO HARM & prxybb)
htmlContent:
GULLIVR, a rap duo from Chicago has released a new track titled "DEPRAVING," a cloud rap and trap song with heavy 808s and psychedelic synths featuring NO HARM & prxybb). DEPRAVING is a type of music people run to, as it brings light to their life and makes the world a more enjoyable place to be.
